detail: A-One Steels India Limited has launched its Initial Public Offering (IPO) totaling ₹405 crore, which includes a fresh issue of up to ₹355 crore and an Offer for Sale of up to ₹50 crore by the Promoter Selling Shareholders. Vidhigya Associates acted as the sole legal counsel for the IPO. The transaction team consisted of Rahul Pandey (Managing Partner), Himanshu Pandey (Partner) and Vidisha Shetty (Associate). A-One Steels India Limited is a backward/vertically integrated steel manufacturer based in southern India, with a diversified product portfolio comprising sponge iron, MS billets, TMT bars, HR coils, CR coils, GP coils, HR pipes, CR pipes, GP pipes, ferro alloys, coal, iron ore, scrap,…
